sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No. 3755 of 2020
O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.430 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Lalapet Police Station, Guntur Urban,
Guntur District, against the petitioners for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 269, 272, 273 IPC; Section 51(a) of DMA, 2005; Sections 58, 59 & 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and 3 EDA.

entities.text:
Lalapet Police Station, Guntur Urban,
Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has placed reliance on the order dated 21.07.2020 passed in Criminal Petition No.2600 of 2020 by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the FIR may be quashed against the petitioners.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not oppose the said submission.

Considering the submissions and in view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the criminal petition is allowed and proceedings in FIR No.430 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Lalapet Police Station, Guntur Urban, Guntur District, against the petitioners, are hereby quashed;
